title: Cost of Living in Temple TX (2026) — What You'll Actually Pay
description:
Thinking about moving to Temple, Texas? In this video, I break down the real cost of living in Temple, including home prices, rent, property taxes, insurance, electricity, and the Temple vs. Belton tradeoff.

I also cover what first-time buyers, Baylor Scott & White relocators, military families, and buy-and-hold investors should watch for before making a move. Temple is more affordable than Austin on paper, but there are a few hidden costs that can surprise people if they only look at list price or rent.

In this video:
• Temple median home price range
• Typical rent for apartments and single-family homes
• Temple vs. Belton housing costs
• Bell County property tax reality
• Homestead exemption savings
• Why investors need to underwrite taxes differently
• Insurance costs after recent storms
• Electricity, Energy Ogre, and utility budgeting
• Whether Temple is actually affordable
